card.name: mg after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit mg right after a number in a dosing sentence, such as a starting or recommended dose of a named tablet or capsule. It is usually followed by a frequency like twice daily.

modes.label: Starting or recommended dose
modes.description: mg after a number in a recommended or initial dose statement.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose is 500<< mg>> once daily for 1 week, thereafter

modes.label: Dose in other settings
modes.description: mg after a number in trial, interaction or dose-adjustment text.
modes.example: patients started on metformin hydrochloride tablets 500<< mg>> and glyburide 20 mg
